title: SibuJS components.json
description: Project configuration for `sibujs init` and `sibujs add`: where copied sibujs-ui components go and which import aliases they use. Every key is optional; missing values are derived from `aliases` and tsconfig `paths`.

style.description: `default` (neutral tokens) or a sibujs-ui color theme: blue, green, red, orange, amber, yellow, teal, purple, violet, rose. `sibujs init` installs the matching `theme-<style>` item.

version.description: Tailwind CSS major version. sibujs-ui components require 4.

css.description: Project stylesheet that imports Tailwind, relative to the project root. Style and theme `@import` lines are added to it. null: print them instead.
Same as `tailwind.css`; accepted so a file written by the sibujs-ui CLI works unchanged. `tailwind.css` wins when both are set.

registry.description: Registry to read items from: a directory, a base URL (`<base>/<name>.json`), or a URL template containing `{name}`. Defaults to https://unpkg.com/sibujs-ui@latest/dist/registry. Overridden by --registry and $SIBUJS_REGISTRY.

aliases.description: Bare import specifiers. They must resolve in your tsconfig `paths` and your bundler; `sibujs init` declares `@/*` for you.

components.description: Root of your components. `ui` defaults to `<components>/ui`.

ui.description: Where copied components (registry:ui) are imported from.

lib.description: Shared helpers, types and icons (registry:lib). Defaults to the directory of `utils`.

paths.description: Directories relative to the project root. Each defaults to where its alias points through tsconfig `paths`.

styles.description: Base stylesheet and themes. Defaults to `styles/sibujs-ui` next to `lib`.
